replies.author: Sevoo
replies.body:
1. Skype? SevoMC

2. Position? Anything but defense is fine for me but I prefer rushing and/or supporting rushers.

3. Past experience? (Tournaments, the teams you were on in them, and their leaders)

As of right now only Tourney 4, with Cacal. I don't have a lot of past competitive experience but I've been on Avicus for around 3 years now so I think I know what I'm doing for the most part.

Some things to note about me. I get extremely good ping, I can ninja bridge, bleeple, etc. I'm good when it comes to fighting and I can take multiple players at once especially if it means protecting someone while they are capturing/breaking the objective. I'm fairly skilled with a bow but I'm better at sword.

I have TS and I can speak with a good quality microphone but I'd say my biggest flaw is team play and communication because of me mainly playing public Avicus with almost 0 communication. When you guys want me to speak up, say so.

Thanks, hope I get trialed ^_^
